name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I want to be direct about where I fit and where I don't. I haven't run Kubernetes clusters or architected cloud networking, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise. What I do have is genuine, daily hands-on time in the LLM ecosystem: evaluating and piloting AI tools and automation platforms, architecting agent systems for real clients, and writing the prompts and agent instructions that turn a business owner's loosely formed idea into something that actually runs. That's the part of this role I could do well from day one.

The infrastructure depth is the real gap, and the fastest way I know to close a gap like that is the same way I picked up SQL, Power BI, and agentic AI system design in the first place: hands-on, because I wanted to understand it, not because a job required it. I also bring direct B2B sales experience into healthcare (Birdeye) and financial services (Fetch & Funnel), regulated-adjacent verticals your nice-to-haves call out specifically.

If the AI-fluency and customer-facing technical translation matter more to you right now than a finished infrastructure background, I'd welcome the conversation. I'm at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
